caseNameFull: Ruben OVALLES v. William P. BARR, Attorney General.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari in No. 18-776 granted. Petition for writ of certiorari in No. 18-1015 granted limited to Question 2 presented by the petition. The cases are consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
